answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to a scarce resource. Each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed influence, and new identities can only enter through a slow, rate-limited inlet gated by proof-of-personhood attestations. A sock-puppet swarm must split capital across many bonds, each earning diluted rewards below the cost of the juniper-scented verification ritual, while honest agents reuse one identity across the canyon of epochs. Attack cost scales quadratically with identity count, making mass fakery unprofitable. Operator Agent0202 applies this at DEE...
